name: 趙莊敏
objective: This course is to build up the financial framework for students when making financial decisions. The focus is on setting out the basic principles of financial management and applying them to the main decisions faced by the financial managers. It helps students to understand various tools of financial management and use them effectively when making investment and financing decisions.
課程進度(1-16週):
1 Introduction
2 The Firm and the Financial Manager
3 Financial Markets and Intermediaries
4 Midterm Report I
5 Midterm Report I
6 Film Viewing and Reflection
7 Midterm Report II
8 Midterm Report II
9 Midterm Week – Report Revision and Consultation
10 Time Value of Money
11 Valuing Bonds
12 Mini Case Discussion
13 Valuing Stocks
14 NPV and Other Investment Criteria
15 Research Paper Presentation
16 Research Paper Presentation
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Week 17 – Review and Revision
Students review previously completed course assignments, case analyses, or research work based on course content and instructor feedback, and select one piece of work to revise and improve.

Week 18 – Refinement and Submission
Students complete the revision of the selected work and submit the revised version.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          The submitted revised work will be used to assess how well students have incorporated feedback and applied relevant course concepts.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          10%
